title: Trump Asks Supreme Court to Overturn $83.3 Million Award in Carroll Defamation Case
summary: President Trump paid E. Jean Carroll more than $5 million from a 2023 lawsuit, but he is now asking the court to overturn a much larger award that a jury ordered him to pay in 2024 for defaming her.
